ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a tripolar grid type and 0.66 x 0.66 degree resolution.
description: Nominal 2/3 degree MOM6 tripolar grid (ORCA-type) for v points, with enhanced meridional resolution reaching 1/4 degree at the Equator.  dx ranging from ~0.7 m to ~74 km due to grid distortion near the fold. dy ranging from ~0.9 km to ~70 km.
